import math
import unittest

from solution import BlockCompactor


class BlockCompactorTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def pairs(self, blocks):
        return [(block.start, block.end) for block in blocks]

    def test_constructor_and_writable_attributes(self):
        block = BlockCompactor.Block(1, 2.5)
        self.assertEqual((block.start, block.end), (1, 2.5))
        block.start = 0
        block.end = 3
        self.assertEqual((block.start, block.end), (0, 3))
        self.assertEqual(self.pairs(BlockCompactor.merge([BlockCompactor.Block(1, 1)])), [(1, 1)])

    def test_sort_overlap_and_copying(self):
        inputs = [
            BlockCompactor.Block(5, 6),
            BlockCompactor.Block(1, 3),
            BlockCompactor.Block(2, 4),
            BlockCompactor.Block(8, 9),
        ]
        original = self.pairs(inputs)
        result = BlockCompactor.merge(inputs)
        self.assertEqual(self.pairs(result), [(1, 4), (5, 6), (8, 9)])
        self.assertEqual(self.pairs(inputs), original)
        self.assertTrue(all(output is not source for output in result for source in inputs))

    def test_touching_rule_and_zero_length_blocks(self):
        blocks = [BlockCompactor.Block(0, 1), BlockCompactor.Block(1, 2)]
        self.assertEqual(self.pairs(BlockCompactor.merge(blocks)), [(0, 1), (1, 2)])
        self.assertEqual(self.pairs(BlockCompactor.merge(blocks, True)), [(0, 2)])

        points = [BlockCompactor.Block(1, 1), BlockCompactor.Block(1, 1)]
        self.assertEqual(self.pairs(BlockCompactor.merge(points)), [(1, 1), (1, 1)])
        self.assertEqual(self.pairs(BlockCompactor.merge(points, True)), [(1, 1)])

    def test_empty_and_iterable_input(self):
        self.assertEqual(BlockCompactor.merge([]), [])
        generated = (BlockCompactor.Block(i, i + 1) for i in (2, 0))
        self.assertEqual(self.pairs(BlockCompactor.merge(generated)), [(0, 1), (2, 3)])

    def test_invalid_endpoints(self):
        for start, end in ((True, 1), (0, False), ("0", 1), (0, None)):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                BlockCompactor.Block(start, end)
        for start, end in ((2, 1), (math.nan, 1), (0, math.inf), (-math.inf, 0)):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                BlockCompactor.Block(start, end)

    def test_invalid_merge_arguments(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            BlockCompactor.merge(None)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            BlockCompactor.merge([BlockCompactor.Block(0, 1), (1, 2)])
        for value in (0, 1, None, "yes"):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                BlockCompactor.merge([], value)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
